rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something happening suddenly and without warning.

example.english: They left abruptly, and nobody knew what was going on.
example.traditional: 佢突然走咗，大家都唔知咩事。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dat6 jin4 zau2 zo2 daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 zi1 me1 si6

rows.note: Use this when something happens out of the blue, especially for no apparent reason.

example.english: They abruptly called me and asked whether I wanted to eat.
example.traditional: 佢無啦啦打電話嚟，問我食唔食飯。
example.jyutping: keoi5 mou4 laa1 laa1 daa2 din6 waa2 lei4 man6 ngo5 sik6 m4 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this as a spoken variant when you want to foreground the sudden moment of a change or action.

example.english: The weather abruptly turned cold, so everyone had to put on another layer.
example.traditional: 天氣突然間轉冷，大家都要着多件衫。
example.jyutping: tin1 hei3 dat6 jin4 gaan1 zyun2 laang5 daai6 gaa1 dou1 jiu3 zoek3 do1 gin6 saam1
